description: This Java class 'ExpectationInitializerLoader' loads and initializes expectations for the MockServer framework, including reading expectations from JSON files and class initializers, and logging relevant events.

classes.name: ExpectationInitializerLoader
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading expectations from JSON files and class initializers, and updating request matchers accordingly.

methods.name: ExpectationInitializerLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the loader with configuration, logger, and request matchers, and triggers expectation loading.

methods.name: expandedInitializationJsonPaths
methods.description: Static method to expand file path globs into a list of JSON expectation file paths.

methods.name: addExpectationsFromInitializer
methods.description: Loads expectations from JSON files and class initializers, adding them to request matchers.

methods.name: retrieveExpectationsFromInitializerClass
methods.description: Loads expectations by instantiating a class specified in configuration.

methods.name: retrieveExpectationsFromFile
methods.description: Reads expectations from specified JSON files, logs events, and updates matchers.

methods.name: loadExpectations
methods.description: Loads and combines expectations from class initializers and JSON files for testing.
